history.criterion: Shadow direction and softness on the plaza match the reference.
history.note: Link's shadow on the plaza falls to the lower right; the reference's falls to the lower left, a mirrored direction (take-0116-W30b-A-link-shadow.jpg at 3x). Our shadow is also short and hard-edged where the reference's is long, soft and about 1.2 times his projected height, and almost nothing else in the plaza casts a readable shadow, so the surface reads evenly lit. This restates the conflict already on file in gauntlet/RUBRIC_PROPOSALS.md: the rubric's own auto window pins azimuth to [-155, -105] and the audit sits at -128 with elevation 38, both inside the window, while ANALYSIS.md section 7 triangulates the reference sun to the opposite side. The criterion as written is not met by the frame, and the fix path is the owner's decision on the proposal, not a lighting change.
